description: This file contains functions and scripts related to platform-specific upgrade procedures for different hardware devices. It includes initialization, upgrade, and configuration steps tailored for various device models, primarily for embedded Linux devices.

methods.name: asus_initial_setup
methods.description: Initializes UBI for Asus devices if running on initramfs, removing existing volumes and creating new ones.

methods.name: xiaomi_initial_setup
methods.description: Sets up UBI and uboot environment for Xiaomi devices, formatting MTD partitions and configuring environment variables.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs device-specific upgrade procedures based on device model, calling appropriate upgrade functions.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Verifies the integrity and type of the firmware image before upgrade, based on device type.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies device-specific configuration after upgrade, including eMMC configs where applicable.

methods.name: platform_pre_upgrade
methods.description: Runs pre-upgrade initialization scripts like initial setup for specific device models.
